summary: GoldMining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) carrying a November 5, 2026 news release. The Company reported commencement of environmental and socioeconomic baseline studies for the EIA/RIMA permitting process at its 100%-owned São Jorge Gold Project in Pará, Brazil, alongside a previously announced pre-feasibility study. SLR Consulting leads PFS engineering and metallurgy; CLAM Environmental leads permitting baseline work. Three rigs are drilling a planned 6,000-metre infill program, over 1,000 metres completed. No transaction terms, no special-situation event; operational permitting and study update only.
